name: Agathelos the Raging
summary: Deep within Razorfen Kraul, Agathelos the Raging is penned among the thorned tunnels. His great size matters to the quilboar, who revere Agamaggan as their god and progenitor, and rage makes the armored boar more fearsome still. His strength and mass make him one of the most dangerous beasts beneath the southern Barrens.

sections.title: Avatars of the Great Boar
sections.body: Agamaggan, a titanic boar, is the god and progenitor of the quilboar. Among the Razorfen tribes, a beast as large as Agathelos carries deep spiritual meaning. He stands roughly twice as tall as a Barrens thunder lizard.

sections.title: Kept in Chains
sections.body: The quilboar keep Agathelos from roaming freely through the Kraul. Several guards maintain a field in front of the short, dead-end tunnel where he is penned. Intruders who break through the barrier face a raging beast, made even bigger and more terrifying by his fury.

faq.answer: Agathelos is a naturally colossal armored boar, roughly twice the size of a common thunder lizard. He grows even bigger when enraged. The quilboar revere Agamaggan, their titanic boar god and progenitor, so a beast of Agathelos's size carries great spiritual meaning.

faq.q: Why do the quilboar keep him locked behind a barrier?
faq.answer: The quilboar pen Agathelos in a short tunnel behind a field maintained by several guards. The barrier keeps the monstrous, raging boar from roaming the Kraul freely.

faq.q: What is his connection to Agamaggan?
faq.answer: Agamaggan is the great boar Ancient and progenitor of the quilboar. His ancestry gives a gigantic boar like Agathelos great spiritual meaning to the quilboar.
Agathelos is a beast, not a creation. The Death's Head quilboar of Razorfen Kraul keep him in a guarded tunnel deep within the thorns.
No. Agathelos is an elite, heavily armored monster, too dangerous for a hunter to bring under control.

angles.text: As a hunter, you can admire Agathelos's predatory bulk, but his endless rage makes him a beast to slay rather than tame.
As a druid, you hold Agamaggan in high esteem as one of the great Ancients who fell during the War of the Ancients. Seeing one of his colossal kin penned and raging in the Kraul is grim.
As a tauren attuned to the earth, you know the legends of Agamaggan. The quilboar's corruption of his kindred beasts marks the rot spreading through the Barrens.
